How were you both rethinking video games and real-time animation at EVL, making interactive work that didn't center violence or points, like Jane's Warpitout and Vizgame ? The Zgrass was built on the hardware of the Bally Arcade, the same system Dave Nutting Associates used to develop several Bally/Midway games. Tom DeFanti at EVL took that machine, added memory and a keyboard, and ported his GRASS language from the PDP-11 to create Zgrass, named for its Z80 processor.
